To set up a custom domain for your support portal, you’ll need two DNS records added at your DNS provider:
1. **CNAME record** – points the subdomain you want to use (e.g., support.yourcompany.com) to Meridian’s portal address.
2. **TXT record** – used by Meridian to verify that you own the domain before the custom domain is activated.
You can enter your desired domain in Settings → General → Custom domain, and the page will show the exact values to use for both records. After adding them, verification runs automatically (it may take up to your DNS provider’s propagation time).
